doc: /** * Weighted final grade calculation followed by letter-grade conversion. */ public class FinalGradeCalculator { private final GradeScale scale; public FinalGradeCalculator(GradeScale scale) { this.scale = scale; } public String compute(List<ComponentMark> marks, Map<String, Double> weights) { double total = 0.0; double weightSum = 0.0; for (ComponentMark m : marks) { Double w = weights.get(m.getComponentCode()); if (w == null) continue; total += m.getPercent() * w; weightSum += w; } if (weightSum <= 0.0) { throw new IllegalStateException("No weighted components recorded"); } double normalised = total / weightSum; return scale.letterFor(normalised); } }

doc: /* grade_export.c - export final grades as CSV, excluding withdrawn students */ #include <stdio.h> #include "grades_db.h" int export_grades(const char *term, const char *path) { FILE *out = fopen(path, "w"); if (!out) return -1; fprintf(out, "student_id,course_code,percent,letter\n"); db_cursor_t *cur = NULL; if (db_open_grade_cursor(&cur, term) != DB_OK) { fclose(out); return -2; } grade_row_t row; int rows = 0; while (db_grade_cursor_next(cur, &row) == DB_OK) { if (row.status == ENROLMENT_WITHDRAWN) continue; fprintf(out, "%s,%s,%.2f,%s\n", row.student_id, row.course_code, row.percent, row.letter); rows++; } db_close_cursor(cur); fclose(out); return rows; }

doc: /** * Escalates tickets that have breached their SLA deadline without resolution. */ public class SlaBreachEscalator { private final TicketRepository tickets; private final SlaCalculator slaCalculator; public SlaBreachEscalator(TicketRepository tickets, SlaCalculator slaCalculator) { this.tickets = tickets; this.slaCalculator = slaCalculator; } public int escalateBreaches(Instant now) { int escalated = 0; for (Ticket t : tickets.findOpenTickets()) { Duration allowed = slaCalculator.allowedFor(t.getPriority(), t.getCustomerTier()); Instant deadline = t.getOpenedAt().plus(allowed); if (now.isAfter(deadline) && t.getStatus() != TicketStatus.ESCALATED) { t.setStatus(TicketStatus.ESCALATED); t.setEscalatedAt(now); tickets.save(t); escalated++; } } return escalated; } }

doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Canonicalize ASCII references received from school term terminals. */ bool normalize_school_term_ref(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst) return false; size_t first = 0, last = strlen(src); while (first < last && src[first] == ' ') ++first; while (last > first && src[last - 1] == ' ') --last; size_t size = last - first; if (!size || cap <= size) return false; /* memmove allows source and destination to overlap. */ memmove(dst, src + first, size); for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) { unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)dst[i]; if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') dst[i] = (char)(ch - 'a' + 'A'); } dst[size] = '\0'; return true; }

doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Canonicalize ASCII references received from learning assignment terminals. */ bool normalize_learning_assignment_ref(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst) return false; size_t first = 0, last = strlen(src); while (first < last && src[first] == ' ') ++first; while (last > first && src[last - 1] == ' ') --last; size_t size = last - first; if (!size || cap <= size) return false; /* memmove allows source and destination to overlap. */ memmove(dst, src + first, size); for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) { unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)dst[i]; if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') dst[i] = (char)(ch - 'a' + 'A'); } dst[size] = '\0'; return true; }
